description: Presidential Secretariat - Call out with Effect from 22.11.2023 All the member of the Armed Forces for the Maintenance of Public Order in the Area
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it involves the application of existing legislation (Public Security Ordinance, Chapter 40) and the issuance of a formal order with legal effect, specifying the areas and forces involved. While it mentions the President by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather the execution of legal authority under existing regulations.
